excluded_datasets.zh: 榜单中多项均值与标准差和 P-gp 页面相同；相关记录未收录，六方法数据不完整。
excluded_datasets.en: Several leaderboard means and standard deviations repeat P-gp entries. Those rows are excluded, leaving incomplete coverage for the six methods.

excluded_datasets.zh: KPGT 补充材料写为 1,614 个分子，TDC 为 1,797；该方法的这项成绩未纳入对比。
excluded_datasets.en: KPGT lists 1,614 molecules, versus 1,797 in TDC; its result is excluded from the comparison.

excluded_datasets.zh: KPGT 补充表标为 AUPRC，TDC 使用 AUROC；该方法的这项成绩未纳入对比。
excluded_datasets.en: KPGT labels the metric AUPRC, while TDC uses AUROC; its result is excluded from the comparison.

zh.representation: 分子图、原子环境与图中相对位置
zh.learning: 解耦注意力 Transformer；自监督预训练、活性任务监督预训练、端点微调。
zh.setting: 约 8.42 亿分子自监督预训练，再用 ChEMBL 活性数据训练；作者从两阶段训练数据中排除 TDC 测试分子。汇总采用 Table 1 的微调模型。

en.representation: Molecular graphs, atom environments and relative graph positions
en.learning: Disentangled-attention Transformer; self-supervised pretraining, activity-supervised pretraining and endpoint fine-tuning.
en.setting: Self-supervised pretraining on about 842 million molecules, followed by ChEMBL activity training. The authors remove TDC test molecules from both training stages. Results use the fine-tuned model in Table 1.

zh.representation: 分子线图、分子指纹与理化描述符
zh.learning: LiGhT Transformer；知识引导预训练与下游微调。
zh.setting: 约 200 万个 ChEMBL29 分子预训练；采用 Supplementary Table 8 的 TDC 实验。原文报告骨架 7:1:2 划分、五次运行。

en.representation: Molecular line graphs, fingerprints and physicochemical descriptors
en.learning: LiGhT Transformer with knowledge-guided pretraining and downstream fine-tuning.
en.setting: Pretrained on about two million ChEMBL29 molecules. Results use the TDC experiments in Supplementary Table 8, reported with a 7:1:2 scaffold split and five runs.

zh.representation: ECFP、Avalon、ErG 指纹及理化描述符
zh.learning: 组合固定分子特征，用 CatBoost 训练端点模型。
zh.setting: 使用作者的 TDC 榜单提交成绩；与增加 GNN 特征的变体分别统计。

en.representation: ECFP, Avalon and ErG fingerprints plus physicochemical descriptors
en.learning: CatBoost endpoint models trained on combined molecular features.
en.setting: Uses the authors' TDC leaderboard submission, tracked separately from the variant with GNN features.

zh.representation: MapLight 特征加预训练 GIN 表示
zh.learning: 将 GIN 特征与分子指纹、描述符组合后输入 CatBoost。
zh.setting: 作者实现通过 molfeat 提取 GIN supervised-masking 特征；这是增加图表示的 CatBoost 变体。

en.representation: MapLight features plus pretrained GIN representations
en.learning: CatBoost using GIN features together with fingerprints and descriptors.
en.setting: The authors' implementation obtains GIN supervised-masking features through molfeat. This is the CatBoost variant augmented with graph representations.

zh.representation: 有向键分子图与 RDKit 描述符
zh.learning: D-MPNN 聚合有向键消息，结合分子描述符预测端点。
zh.setting: 采用名为 Chemprop-RDKit 的 TDC 提交；其成绩与原论文中的其他划分及 Chemprop 变体分别记录。

en.representation: Directed-bond molecular graphs and RDKit descriptors
en.learning: D-MPNN aggregates directed-bond messages and combines them with molecular descriptors.
en.setting: Uses the TDC submission named Chemprop-RDKit, distinct from other splits and Chemprop variants in the original paper.

zh.representation: 原子与化学键构成的分子图
zh.learning: 图注意力聚合原子邻域，并用注意力读出分子表示。
zh.setting: 采用 TDC 榜单中的 AttentiveFP 实现成绩；原论文的随机划分实验保留在论文笔记中。

en.representation: Molecular graphs with atom and bond features
en.learning: Graph attention aggregates atomic neighborhoods and reads out a molecular representation.
en.setting: Uses the AttentiveFP implementation on the TDC leaderboard. Original-paper random-split experiments remain in the paper note.

zh.representation: 筛选后的 PaDEL 理化描述符
zh.learning: 先比较分子表示与 AutoML 模型，再对 XGBoost 进行特征筛选和调参。
zh.setting: 榜单模型为 XGBoost 回归器；采用五个种子的 0.256±0.006，而非论文单次实验的 0.2525。

en.learning: Representation and AutoML screening followed by feature selection and XGBoost tuning.
en.setting: The submitted model is an XGBoost regressor. The score is 0.256±0.006 over five seeds; the paper's single-run 0.2525 is a separate result.

zh.representation: 将分子描述符排列成二维特征图
zh.learning: 卷积神经网络学习描述符特征图与端点之间的关系。
zh.setting: D 为描述符分支；特征布局由大规模分子数据学习。这里只收录该实现的 Caco-2 榜单成绩。

en.representation: Molecular descriptors arranged into two-dimensional feature maps
en.learning: A convolutional neural network predicts endpoints from descriptor maps.
en.setting: D denotes the descriptor branch; feature layout is learned from a large molecular collection. This catalog currently records its Caco-2 leaderboard result.
